person_reference.name: マーク・スミス（Mark Smith）
person_reference.selection_method: 固定source.txtに掲載されたベスト5・サブ5の30名から、Python random.Random('0289cbfa82d3e10329fb').choice(rows)で1名を選択。特定選手が主役ではない比較記事のため、本人指定の第1優先群（本文に名前が出ている選手）から選んだ。
person_reference.reference_scope: 容姿のみ。外部ページの成績・日程は画像の本文根拠に使用していない。
person_reference.appearance_checked: 公式プロフィール写真を実際に目視。短い黒い巻き髪、長めの卵形の輪郭、眉・目鼻、薄い口ひげと顎のひげ、肩幅を参照。修正版では濃い顎ひげを弱め、輪郭を参照写真に寄せた。
person_reference.depiction: ドライブする姿の手描きイラスト。特定試合・実際の場面の再現ではない。氏名・個人成績・出場・活躍の文言なし。写真の貼付なし、ロゴ・スポンサー文字なし。

brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail for バスケまとめ, landscape 16:9, 2048 x 1152 pixels, PNG, opaque background.
Style: approved hand-drawn ink-and-dry-brush sports editorial illustration. Near-black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B brush strokes, ivory Japanese lettering, orange basketball. Strong black and ivory sketch strokes on the player with restrained warm skin tone. Bold graphic illustration, never photography or photorealism. Few elements, confident open composition, highly readable mobile thumbnail.

Subject: ONE real basketball player, Mark Smith (マーク・スミス), likeness based on the official B.LEAGUE 2026-27 profile portrait just inspected at https://www.bleague.jp/files/user/roster/693/2026-27/51000410_03.png . He is a muscular athletic male guard, broad shoulders, medium warm brown skin, short tightly curled dark hair with a low rounded top and close tapered sides, clear forehead, thick dark fairly straight eyebrows, almond shaped dark eyes, long oval face with a gently squared jaw, broad straight nose, subtle thin moustache and short faint chin stubble, ears visible. Preserve these individual facial proportions in expressive ink drawing. No beard or long hair. Three-quarter face with focused eyes. Do not use the face of Jarrett Culver or Jordan Faison from earlier style examples.

Action/composition: Put Mark Smith in the LEFT approximately 45% of the canvas, a dynamic forward drive while controlling one orange ball with his right hand at hip height, torso leaning toward center, knees bent, three-quarter athletic pose. His face is large and clearly visible. His left arm balances naturally. Show both arms and anatomically correct visible hands; no extra digits or limbs. Keep the entire basketball, both hands, face, and head well within the canvas. Plain ivory and dark sleeveless basketball jersey and shorts with NO insignia, sponsors, letters, numbers, crests or logos. The pose is an imagined generic basketball movement, not a depiction of an actual match or event. No opponent or other people. Lime sweeping diagonal brush marks behind him suggest motion without crossing the text.

Layout: Right 55% contains the type on clean dark space. Big bold Japanese gothic text. All glyphs must be correct and sharp. Safe margin at least 70px around canvas. Main words are very large ivory and lime. Keep annotations readable, not microscopic. Footer has a clean dark background. Do not copy any name, score or number from the style reference.
Render ONLY the following text, verbatim:
Small header at upper right: 「バスケまとめ」
Date badge beneath header: 「11/08 試合前」
Main title on two lines: 「登録選手」 then 「ベスト5」 (the 5 is part of the ranking format, not a player's statistic)
Subtitle: 「リーグ別・今季平均EFFで選出」
Important qualifier below subtitle, in a clearly visible ivory line: 「出場確定ではありません」
Bottom footer, with ample margins: 「イラスト（AI生成）」 and 「イメージ」

Editorial basis is only the frozen source.html/source.txt for article-results-one-next-20261108.html. The article lists separate league best fives selected from registered players using season average EFF before the November 8 games. It does not confirm participation or final results. Mark Smith was randomly selected from the 30 names in the article to be the illustrative subject. Thus do not print his name, team, personal score, stats, participation, achievement or a claimed performance. No win/loss score, no result headlines, no performance-based caption. No team logos, no league logo, no official photograph pixels, no sponsor text, no watermark, no signature. The exact AI label and イメージ annotation must remain visible.
Final visual should feel energetic, polished and distinctly hand illustrated, with player likeness and Japanese readability given priority.

ONE QA REVISION
Edit the first image, the existing basketball thumbnail. The second image is an official portrait of the SAME real player Mark Smith, only for facial likeness reference, never to paste into the artwork.

Make this single final QA correction pass:
1. Reframe the illustrated player on the LEFT: scale his entire illustrated figure and basketball down to about 85% of their current size within the left section and move them inward. The entire basketball and ALL fingertips on BOTH hands MUST be visible, with at least 45 pixels of clear margin from the left and bottom canvas edges. His head must have at least 40 pixels above it. Keeping his lower thighs cropped is fine, but never crop the ball, fingers, hands, head or arms. Preserve the energetic driving pose and natural anatomy.
2. Refine the illustrated face to clearly resemble the official portrait: short low tightly-curled hair, moderately long oval face, less angular cheekbones, gently squared jaw, wider nose tip, straight dark eyebrows, thin subtle moustache and ONLY very faint short chin stubble. Remove the pronounced goatee/dark chin beard seen in the first thumbnail. Use the reference's facial proportions, a focused playing expression, and maintain obvious hand-drawn ink illustration.
3. Preserve all other design decisions: black #151A18 / lime #CCF43B / ivory graphic brush style, orange ball, plain unbranded uniform, same text hierarchy, exactly the following Japanese wording:
バスケまとめ
11/08 試合前
登録選手
ベスト5
リーグ別・今季平均EFFで選出
出場確定ではありません
イラスト（AI生成）
イメージ
Do not alter spelling, add any text, add player names, jersey numbers, logos, statistics or results. Maintain the left player / right text split, but reduce the main type very slightly if necessary to keep safe margins. Ensure every text glyph is fully inside the canvas and legible.
This is a conceptual illustration, not a real match reconstruction. No photorealism or photo pixels. Output ONE landscape PNG at about 16:9, ideally 2048x1152, minimum width 1000 pixels.
